---
title: Deploy a template
description: Deploy a ready-made app from the template catalog. A template can add several services at once, such as an app and its database.
---

Templates are ready-made apps from the StackBlaze catalog. Picking one deploys it right away, with every service it needs. This guide uses **uptime-kuma**, which adds the app, a MariaDB database and an Email add-on.

<Steps>

<Step>

### Open the add menu

In your project, click **+ Service** in the canvas toolbar (or press **Ctrl+K**). Pick **Template** ("One-click apps from the catalog").

<Screenshot id="templates/1-add-menu" alt="The add menu with Template at the top" />

</Step>

<Step>

### Find the template

The **Templates** list opens. Scroll it, or type in **Search templates**. The **All** menu next to the search box filters the list.

<Screenshot id="templates/2-list" alt="The Templates list" />

<Screenshot id="templates/3-search" alt="Searching for uptime: uptime-kuma, Self-hosted uptime monitoring" />

</Step>

<Step>

### Pick it

Click the template. There is no extra confirmation: StackBlaze deploys it at once. Every service the template needs appears on the canvas, marked **Deploying**.

<Screenshot id="templates/4-deploying" alt="uptime-kuma and MariaDB on the canvas, Deploying" />

</Step>

<Step>

### Wait for Running

When every service shows **Running**, the app card shows its public URL.

<Screenshot id="templates/5-running" alt="uptime-kuma and MariaDB, Running, with the app's URL" />

</Step>

<Step>

### Open the app

Click the URL on the app's card.

<Screenshot id="templates/6-app" alt="Uptime Kuma, open at the app's URL" />

</Step>

</Steps>

The services a template adds are ordinary services: open them on the canvas to change their [variables](/configure/environment-variables) and [settings](/configure/service-settings).

## From a template's own page

Each template also has its own page, `/new/template/<name>`, for example `/new/template/uptime-kuma`. Links to a template from outside the dashboard lead there.

<Steps>

<Step>

### Choose a project

**Deploy uptime-kuma** describes the app. Under **Choose a project**, keep **New project** ("A new project in US Central.") or pick one of your projects ("Added next to what is already in this project.").

<Screenshot id="templates/9-project-picker" alt="The Project menu: New project and your existing projects" />

</Step>

<Step>

### Review and deploy

**Review what gets created** lists everything the template adds, here **uptime-kuma** (App), **MariaDB** (Database) and **Email** (Add-on). Click **Deploy uptime-kuma**.

<Screenshot id="templates/10-review" alt="Deploy uptime-kuma into github-demo-cw8z: Review what gets created, uptime-kuma App, MariaDB Database, Email Add-on" />

The project's canvas opens and the services start. Ours were all up within about a minute: the app and MariaDB **Running**, the Email add-on **Ready**.

<Screenshot id="templates/11-deployed" alt="The canvas with uptime-kuma and MariaDB Running and Email (SMTP) Ready" />

</Step>

</Steps>
